gruppe: tidligere community college-studenter som har sluttet
sammenligning: informasjon og fritak for skolepenger for ett kurs mot kontrollgruppe
sitat: We find that providing information and a one-course tuition waiver to former students increases their likelihood of re-enrollment by 1.5 percentage points (21.1%), enrolling in multiple courses by 0.9 percentage points (16.4%), full-time enrollment by 0.5 percentage points (21.7%), and persistence by 0.6 percentage points (23.1%).
